slides.title: Meet Dot
slides.text: Dot the fox is a data detective. Dot solves cases with facts, not guesses.
slides.alt: Dot the fox stands in the woods and asks the first case's question: who was last in the hall?

focus.cue: This is Dot the fox, a data detective
Dot asks one question per case

slides.title: Data is facts in rows
slides.text: A table holds facts in rows and columns. A table full of facts does not answer anything yet. You have to make the answer show.
slides.alt: Tower Trouble as a table: every row is one team's tower, every column one kind of fact: team, blocks, color.

focus.cue: One column: one kind of fact, blocks

slides.title: Sort or group
slides.text: Sorting puts the rows in order, like smallest to biggest. Grouping puts rows of the same kind together and counts them.
slides.alt: The pet case grouped by pet: one bar per kind, counted. Dog 4, Cat 2, Fish 2.

focus.cue: Grouped by pet: one bar for each kind

slides.title: Who was in the hall last?
slides.text: First find the rows for the place in the question: Hall. Then sort by time: the last Hall row, Gus at 3:10, is your answer.
slides.alt: The hall case sorted by time: Eli, Fay, Kai, Gus, Ida, Jo. The last Hall row is Gus at 3:10.

focus.cue: Sorted by time: the rows run from early to late
Gus, Hall, 3:10: the last Hall row
After 3:10 nobody is in the Hall

slides.title: Show me first
slides.text: Dot has one rule: you can only pin a claim when the view on the screen shows it. Most of each kind? Group and count.
slides.alt: The grouped bars answer the question, so Dot says: that view answers it, pin your claim. The Pin a claim button lights up.

focus.cue: Grouped by pet: this view shows the answer
So Dot says: that view answers it
Now the claim can be pinned

words.means: facts, like names, times and numbers
put rows in order by one column
put the same kinds together and count them

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Data Detective at Sort & Group and solve all 6 cases. For each one ask: which column is the question about?
slides.alt: Dot the fox stands in the woods and asks the first case's question: who was last in the hall?

focus.cue: Dot asks the question: read it first
Which column is it about? Group or sort by it
